faqs.a: Yes, our engineered wood planks feature multi-layered cross-ply cores that prevent expansion under humidity, topped with hard-wearing UV coatings that resist executive shoe scuffs.

faqs.q: Can engineered wood floor planks be resanded and refinished?
faqs.a: Yes, our premium engineered planks feature a thick 3mm to 4mm real hardwood wear layer, allowing them to be sanded and refinished 2 to 3 times over their lifetime.

faqs.q: How do you prevent moisture damage under wooden floors?
faqs.a: We install specialized heavy-duty foam underlays with integrated vapor barriers and leave micro expansion joints along the walls to allow natural breathing.
